test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"must not put himself."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option uses the correct reflexive pronoun **"himself" **to refer back to the subject.
 
• The meaning of the phrase **"put something in"** means to spend a lot of time or effort doing something.
 
 
• **Example**: *You've obviously **put a lot of work in**__ on your garden.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

“Why?" said Harry in surprise, “There is a __plot__, Harry Potter. A plot to make most terrible things __happen__ at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry __this year__," whispered Dobby, suddenly trembling all over. “Dobby has __known it for__ months, sir. Harry Potter __must not put himself__ in peril. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 uses "insert" instead of "put", which is not the correct phrasal verb to use in this context.
 
• Option 2 uses "his self" instead of "himself", which is not the correct reflexive pronoun.
 
• Option 3 uses "oneself" instead of "himself", which is not the correct reflexive pronoun to use with the subject "he".
